The tetragonal structure of Co7O4F14 (space group I4/mmm, No. 143) has 25 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows octahedral Co centers coordinated by four F and two O neighbors, with Co–O distances of 1.8352 Å and Co–F distances of 2.0141–2.2089 Å. The F and O centers each have three Co neighbors. Validated polyhedral contacts reveal corner-sharing between Co octahedra, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
